text:
Support: customer C reports p99 API latency spiked from ~300ms -> ~1.2s starting 08:10 UTC in eu-west, multiple errors: TLS handshake timeouts and 524 gateway responses. attaching their sample traces.
Anna: sending the customer's trace dump now. they show repeated cross-zone hop: eu-west1-b -> eu-west1-c before reaching our edge.
Anna: paste:
```
GET /v1/generate 200 OK total=1.23s
  client tcp connect=12ms TLS handshake=780ms first_byte=400ms
  path: 10.1.5.4 -> 10.2.3.7 -> 10.3.1.9
```
Raj: seeing similar in our internal probes — p99 rose from 290ms to 1.05s at ~08:09 UTC. DNS changes rolled out at 08:05 per deploy-bot? @eng-infra-bot can you confirm recent GSLB/weight push?
eng-infra-bot: GSLB weight update applied at 08:04:58 UTC to region weights (eu-west increased weight for pool B). rollout completed 08:05:22 UTC.
Lina: could be affinity drift after weight change. when requests route to a different pool we sometimes see additional cross-AZ TLS handshakes due to new session affinity not present.
Mike: steps to repro from our side:
```
# from eu-west probe
dig +short api.redwood.example
traceroute -n <ip>
time curl -w "time_connect:%{time_connect} time_starttransfer:%{time_starttransfer} time_total:%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null -s https://api.redwood.example/v1/ping
```
Mike: output from probe at 08:12:
```
dig -> 35.201.xxx.xxx
traceroute shows extra hop 100ms to 10.2.3.7
curl times: time_connect:0.12 time_starttransfer:0.92 time_total:1.10
```
Raj: that TLS handshake=0.78s matches customer's 780ms. likely a cross-AZ TLS RTT + server-side CPU spike during handshake (crypto).
Anna: customer on Dedicated plan, asked for temporary mitigation (they're seeing user-facing errors). propose temporary: route their account to eu-west pool A (old affinity) and disable GSLB weight change for that account via rollout override.
Lina: can do an account-scoped routing rule. steps: create routing policy -> pin customer to pool A -> invalidate prefix cache for their tokens. rollback action in 30m.
Mike: I'll push the override and run probes, also bump TLS concurrency on pool B as short-term mitigation.
oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-4160009876 (latency: eu-west p99 spike) assigned to @Anna @Raj
Anna: override pushed at 08:18 UTC. internal probe after change: time_total down to 320ms. customer confirms reduced errors in their next 2 mins. marking as mitigated for now.
Raj: follow-ups: 1) correlate TLS worker CPU on pool B at spike time, 2) check if any cert rotation or OCSP issue coincided, 3) schedule rollback of GSLB weight rollout until we have canaries that include TLS handshake histograms.
Lina: I'll open a postmortem and add a small eval to simulate affinity shifts in our staging harness.
Support: customer notified and will keep monitoring. closing escalation if stable for 1h. :thumbsup:
